task: Create a new feature flag named "promo_banner" in the shop project with the description "Gates the promo banner rollout". It must be turned off in every environment.
finalText: DONE: Created feature `promo_banner` (id 765) in the shop project with description "Gates the promo banner rollout"; verified it is off in both Development and Production.
commands: flagsmith feature --help; flagsmith feature create --help; flagsmith config; flagsmith environment --help

flagsmith feature list --json | jq -r '.[]?.name // empty' 2>/dev/null | grep -x promo_banner; echo "---"; flagsmith feature create promo_banner --description "Gates the promo banner rollout" --no-input; echo "exit $?"
flagsmith feature get promo_banner --json 2>&1 | head -c 3000; echo; flagsmith environment list --json 2>&1 | head -c 2000

for k in JBtS2U8FtKiyKdpDCs7s3G 5qWJVfJ9V3jbjx4bMi2AGF; do echo "== $k"; flagsmith -e $k flag list --json 2>&1 | jq -c '.[] | select(.feature.name=="promo_banner" or .name=="promo_banner")' 2>/dev/null || flagsmith -e $k flag list 2>&1 | grep -i promo_banner; done
